title: fix(components): the ui:select label names its combobox through htmlFor and the trigger id (objectui#10435)
body:
Fixes #10435

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ui:select` (`packages/components/src/renderers/form/select.tsx`) now writes `htmlFor={schema.id}` on its `Label` and `id={schema.id}` on the Radix `SelectTrigger`. This is the `record-picker-label-association-5771` shape the triage ruled. Before, neither end carried the wiring. The trigger is a `button` with `role="combobox"`, a role that takes no name from its content, so a labelled select's combobox had an empty accessible name.

- A labelled select authored with an `id` is found by `getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Title' })`.
- A required one's name stays `Title`: the objectui#10368 marker span is `aria-hidden`.
- A select authored without an `id` mints none. Its caption stays unassociated, as on the sibling `input` / `textarea` renderers and `element:record_picker`. This half is pinned as deliberate. See Acceptance notes for the dispatch hypothesis it contradicts.

## Files (vs base `111fa4c`)

| File | + / - |
|---|---|
| `packages/components/src/renderers/form/select.tsx` | +13 / -2 |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/select-label-association.test.tsx` (new, 7 cases) | +128 / -0 |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/required-marker-markup.test.tsx` | +3 / -5 |
| `.changeset/10435-select-label-association.md` (`@object-ui/components` patch) | +20 / -0 |

`required-marker-markup.test.tsx` is outside the claim's declared file surface. Its select site carried the comment "This label carries no `for` today", which this change made false. The comment is rewritten, and the locator becomes `label[for="sel-ctl"]`, the same form as the other five sites.

## Verification, on final head `4e99a54` (merge of `origin/main` `d461b0d`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/form/ packages/components/src/__tests__/required-marker-markup.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/form-renderers.test.tsx` gave exit 0, with `Test Files 67 passed (67)` and `Tests 494 passed | 10 skipped (504)`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/components --concurrency=2` gave exit 0 with `Tasks: 9 successful, 9 total`. It ran on `a75bf59`. The merge after that only touched `packages/app-shell`, `packages/plugin-dashboard`, `content/docs` and two changesets, all outside `@object-ui/components` and its `@object-ui/*` dependencies. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both touched test files.
- eslint on the 3 changed source and test files gave exit 0 with 0 errors and 4 warnings. All 4 warnings are pre-existing on the unchanged signature line, and the BASE `select.tsx` also shows 4.
- These gates each gave exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-lint-coverage`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins` exits 2 with a prerequisite refusal, because it needs a console build. This diff does not change the registration block. That gate is declared to CI.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

The fix was committed first as `a75bf59`. The script then overwrote `select.tsx` with the BASE blob `4296933c`: `htmlFor={schema.id}` count went 1 to 0 on disk and `SelectTrigger id={schema.id}` count went 1 to 0. It ran the pin and `required-marker-markup.test.tsx`, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap.

- Mutated run: exit 1, `Tests 8 failed | 14 passed (22)`.
  - 6 of the 7 new cases failed, starting with `Unable to find an accessible element with the role "combobox" and name "Title"`.
  - The no-`id` case stayed green, as expected.
  - Both select-site cases of `required-marker-markup` failed, because of the tightened `label[for]` locator.
- Restore: file hash `8fc729cb` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch's hypothesis H2 conflicts with the ruled shape. H2 said a select with no `schema.id` still needs a minted id, for example from `useId`. The ruled 5771 shape explicitly declines a `useId()` fallback, and its own test pins the no-`id` case as unassociated. The ruling was followed. The alternative is raised to the dispatching seat as an open question, not decided here.
- Related to that question: the docs catalog examples `components-form-select/basic-select` and `components-form-input/with-label` author a `label` with no `id`. They render an unnamed control under the ruled shape. This is noted, not filed.
